items.title: 1. Gas Particles are in Constant, Random Motion

source_refs.note: 1. Gas Particles are in Constant, Random Motion: a main subheading of 6.1 Assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 119-119.

blocks.text: Gas molecules are in perpetual, random motion. They move in straight lines until they collide with either another molecule or the walls of the container.
